title: Compress PDF for WhatsApp Sharing — Reduce File Size Free
metaDescription: Compress PDF file size to send via WhatsApp and WhatsApp Web. Fast in-browser compression to stay within WhatsApp document sharing limits and save mobile data.
heroHeadline: Compress PDF for WhatsApp document sharing.
heroDescription: Reduce PDF file sizes to send fast on WhatsApp Mobile and WhatsApp Web without data lag or upload timeouts.
privacyNote: Your shared files are compressed locally on your phone or laptop screen.

specs.label: WhatsApp Document Upload Limit
specs.value: 100 MB (Recommended < 16 MB for fast mobile transfer)

sections.heading: Fast document transfer on mobile networks.
body: While WhatsApp technically allows documents up to 100 MB, sending multi-megabyte PDFs over mobile 4G/5G connections wastes cellular data and causes slow downloads for recipients.
Compressing your PDF down to 1 MB – 2 MB makes document delivery instant and smooth.

faq.q: Why should I compress PDFs before sending on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Smaller PDFs transfer instantly, consume significantly less mobile data, and open immediately on the recipient's phone.
